{'text': "德語黑色喜劇《Where's Wanda?》回歸 Apple TV，第二季首集現已上架串流平台。以下係詳細資訊。", 'paragraph_context': 'German-language dark comedy “Where’s Wanda?” is back on Apple TV, with the first episode of its second season now streaming. Here are the details.'}

{'text': "《Where's Wanda?》第二季首播集現已可供串流收看", 'paragraph_context': '‘Where’s Wanda?’ season 2 premiere now available to stream'}

{'text': "Apple TV 今年七月宣佈《Where's Wanda?》將會回歸，並喺幾個星期前發佈預告片之後，第二季首集正式首播。", 'paragraph_context': 'After announcing the return of “Where’s Wanda?” in July and releasing a trailer just a couple of weeks ago, Apple TV has now premiered the first episode of season 2.'}

{'text': '今晚首播距離第一季完結嘅2024年11月13日差不多兩年。Apple TV 喺翌年二月續訂第二季，但要到2026年七月先正式公佈回歸日期。', 'paragraph_context': 'Tonight’s premiere comes nearly two years after the first season ended on November 13, 2024. Apple TV renewed the series for a second season the following February, but it wasn’t until July 2026 that the company announced its return date.'}

{'text': "《Where's Wanda?》講述 Klatt 一家人四出尋找失蹤女兒嘅故事。佢哋對當地警方嘅調查方式愈來愈不滿，決定親自出手，期間揭開咗鄰居嘅黑暗秘密。", 'paragraph_context': '“Where’s Wanda?” follows the Klatt family as they search for their missing daughter. After growing frustrated with the local police’s handling of the investigation, they decide to take matters into their own hands, uncovering their neighbors’ dark secrets along the way.'}

{'text': "今晚首播之後，《Where's Wanda?》第二季餘下七集將會每週播出，一直持續到12月9日。", 'paragraph_context': 'Following tonight’s premiere, the remaining seven episodes of “Where’s Wanda?” season 2 will roll out weekly through December 9.'}

{'text': "以下係 Apple TV 對《Where's Wanda?》第二季嘅內容介紹：", 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s Apple TV on what to expect from the second season of “Where’s Wanda?”:'}

{'text': '第二季入面，Klatt 一家（Makatsch 同 Stein 飾）強勢回歸！正當佢哋以為生活終於回復正常之際，佢哋嘅女兒 Wanda（Drinda 飾）就被人撞破企喺一具屍體旁邊，幾乎可以講係人贓並獲。佢哋必須竭盡所能證明女兒清白，唔想再失去佢，同時搵出真正嘅殺人兇手，調查更將佢哋帶入咗呢個寧靜小鎮嘅罪惡黑社會。但係佢哋保護家人嘅行動究竟可以令全家化險為夷，定係令佢哋越陷越深？佢哋又能否趕喺太遲之前，搵到嗰日究竟發生咗咩事嘅真相？', 'paragraph_context': 'In season two, the Klatts (Makatsch and Stein) are back! Just as they thought their lives were finally returning to normal, their daughter, Wanda (Drinda), is caught seemingly red-handed standing over a dead body. They will need to do everything in their power to prove her innocence and avoid losing her again, as their investigation to find the real murderer takes them into the criminal underbelly of their sleepy suburban town. But will their quest to protect their family get them all out of trouble, or ultimately lead them further astray? And can they find out the truth of what happened on that fateful day before it’s too late?'}
